policy_note: Every declared external surface must have a blocking verification lane and an explicit compatibility contract.

surfaces.name: gemini-api
surfaces.rollback_action: pin SDK version / disable changed lane

surfaces.name: surrealdb-container-image
surfaces.rollback_action: restore previous image tag in workflows and compose
surfaces.incompatibility_semantics: tag drift or smoke failure is blocking

surfaces.name: uv-binary-image
surfaces.rollback_action: restore previous pinned uv image tag in Dockerfiles
surfaces.incompatibility_semantics: floating uv image input is blocking

surfaces.name: node-runtime-image
surfaces.rollback_action: restore previous pinned node runtime image tag in Dockerfiles
surfaces.incompatibility_semantics: floating node runtime image input is blocking

surfaces.name: ghcr-release-images
surfaces.rollback_action: re-publish prior digest / revert release workflow input

surfaces.name: playwright-browser-binaries
surfaces.rollback_action: restore prior playwright version and machine cache root contents

surfaces.name: fastmcp-library
surfaces.rollback_action: restore prior fastmcp range in pyproject.toml and rerun MCP tests
surfaces.incompatibility_semantics: first-party MCP server compatibility drift is blocking

surfaces.name: content-core-library
surfaces.rollback_action: restore prior content-core range in pyproject.toml and rerun source-graph tests
surfaces.incompatibility_semantics: content extraction compatibility drift is blocking

surfaces.name: ai-prompter-library
surfaces.rollback_action: restore prior ai-prompter range in pyproject.toml and rerun graph prompt tests
surfaces.incompatibility_semantics: prompt runtime compatibility drift is blocking

surfaces.name: esperanto-library
surfaces.rollback_action: restore prior esperanto range in pyproject.toml and rerun model/credential tests
surfaces.incompatibility_semantics: model and credential runtime compatibility drift is blocking

surfaces.name: podcast-creator-library
surfaces.rollback_action: restore prior podcast-creator range in pyproject.toml and rerun podcast tests
surfaces.incompatibility_semantics: podcast generation runtime compatibility drift is blocking
